title: The SOLD Ledger: Sportfish & Global Cruiser Edition
description: Efficiency meets offshore endurance in this week’s installment. From the legendary battle-ready hulls of Viking and Bertram to the innovative spaciousness of Silverton, explore the iconic vessels that our specialists have successfully moved across the finish line.
html:
Tournament Ready: Sportfish & Global Cruisers Join The SOLD Ledger

Market momentum continues at Florida Yachts International. This week, we transition from the high-octane day boats to the serious offshore contenders. These sales represent more than just transactions; they represent the trust owners place in our brokers to handle complex, high-value assets with precision.

2010 Viking 54 Convertible

  • Sold by: Ricardo Llorente
  • The Details: “Wet Dream,” a meticulously maintained 2010 Viking 54, stands as a prime example of why the 54C is a tournament favorite. Powered by MAN 1550 CRM engines, she cruises at a comfortable 30 knots.
  • The Edge: With a custom satin teak interior and a factory-installed mezzanine, this vessel was turnkey-ready for its next campaign. Ricardo Llorente leveraged the vessel’s immaculate service history and professional captaincy to secure a result for both buyer and seller.

60’ Bertram

  • Sold by: Joel Gomes
  • The Details: The Bertram 60 is a “fishing fortress,” renowned for its fearsome flared bow and legendary seakeeping ability. It remains a gold standard for anglers who refuse to let the weather dictate their schedule.
  • The Transaction: Sold by Joel Gomes, this 60’ classic highlights the enduring demand for the Bertram brand. Whether destined for tournament circuits or family cruising, this vessel’s spacious four-stateroom layout and heavy-weather performance made it an irresistible asset.

2009 Silverton 52 Ovation

  • Sold by: Arney Mendez
  • The Details: The “Christina Marie” is a sophisticated 52’ motor yacht that punches far above its weight class in terms of volume. Featuring a three-stateroom layout and Volvo IPS 600 engines, it is a masterclass in onboard comfort.
  • The Edge: Arney Mendez highlighted recent high-value upgrades, including a Seakeeper gyro stabilizer and a 2024 hydraulic tender lift. By focusing on these modern amenities, Arney successfully moved this versatile cruiser in a competitive market.

The FYI Advantage

Whether it’s a tournament-proven sportfish or a stabilized family cruiser, our team understands that every vessel has a unique story and a specific buyer. We use data-driven marketing and a 30-year global network to ensure that story ends with a “Sold” sign.
